desc: Read input (N, Q, array A, queries) from stdin.
Coordinate‑compress all A_i and X_i values into sorted unique indices.
Build query list storing (R, original_index, comp_X_idx).
Implement Fenwick tree (BIT) with point‑max update and prefix‑max query.
Sweep i from 1 to N, updating BIT with A[i] as described.
When current i equals a query's R, answer it via BIT.query(comp_X_idx) and store.
After sweep, output answers in the original query order.
